scope: Independent source review and standalone build rerun of peer typed native lock banks
reviewed_contracts: All native CRITICAL_SECTION objects are owned actual SDK objects; invalid bank/index and foreign/misaligned pointer are rejected before native call
Object arrays are stable; class is noncopyable/nonmovable; init/delete/lifetime externally serialized; worker reads initialized bits without concurrent mutation
Full signed BOOL exposed at raw SDK endpoints, uint32 zero extension preserved by recovered uint64 platform endpoints; negative nonzero BOOL marks initialized
Duplicate init and uninitialized enter/leave/delete throw; destructor terminates if initialized object remains, terminal case confirms boundary
Dynamic Ex address must be valid callable SDK/injected proc supplied by trusted resolver; nonzero arbitrary address safety is caller contract, not proven by pointer cast
Real native recursive enter/leave and two joined workers produce40000 protected increments; injected fixtures validate calls, fields, range/ownership and full return bits
limitations: No original DLL/global layout/runtime equivalence, lifetime race model checking or ABI/SEH proof
